description: Convert existing Rspack config(s) that use `withNx` to use `NxAppRspackPlugin`, for projects on the `@nx/rspack:rspack` executor or the `@nx/rspack/plugin` inference plugin. Defaults to migrating all projects. Pass '--project' to migrate only one target.
title: Convert Rspack project using withNx to NxAppRspackPlugin

project.description: The project whose rspack config to convert from the `withNx` plugin to `NxAppRspackPlugin`.

skipFormat.description: Whether to format files at the end of the migration.
